hardware_notes: Use a smooth precision 5 mm running section through each 625ZZ inner race, with M5 threads outside the races or a custom axle.
Modeled M5 heads are low-profile 8.5 mm diameter x 3.5 mm high. Verify supplied screw head envelopes.
Nominal 6 mm shoulder bolts do not fit 5 mm-bore 625ZZ bearings.
M5 clearance holes are nominally 5.3 mm. Calibrate printed fits and bearing seats before assembly.
manufacturing_notes: Individual STEP and STL files share the contact-pose assembly placement. Arrange STL orientations for manufacture.
